# Character gate audit (generated by `tools/body_surface/gates.py audit`)

One row per library character, for the exact file on disk. `eligible` opens the bare body state (with the operator's switch on, for a viewer who has confirmed they are an adult in Private Mode); every other status lists what is missing and who acts. Nothing here is a review, and a user's own adult confirmation never stands in for one.

A review that is `pending` is work not yet done, not a rejection: only a finding a person recorded (`age-ambiguous`, `appears-minor`, `not-assessable`) blocks a file. Body is tracked on its own (CV1's clothing structure for the exact file).
